mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading designates the entire planar rectangle whose area is specified by its side lengths. Right image: The shaded region is the epigraph, the set of points with vertical coordinate at least f(x).
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and selects the epigraph of a function in the right image. The orange interior of the rectangle labeled 1 yd by 2 yd. The gray region above the curve labeled f and marked epi f.
